databaseDetail: By using this service, you agree to a 12-month binding contract. Cancellation is only permitted via certified mail and includes a $45 early termination fee. Your data may be shared with third-party marketing partners.
All transfers are final. The company reserves the right to deduct a 15% 'processing fee' on refunds. Prize claims require an upfront 'verification deposit' as outlined in Section 4(b).
All digital sales are final. No refunds are issued under any circumstances. The company is not liable for games that are unplayable or corrupted.
Returns accepted within 7 days subject to a 25% restocking fee. By claiming this giveaway, you agree to a $99 'shipping insurance' charge and waive all rights to dispute the charge.
Delivery fees are non-refundable. Cancelled orders are subject to a $15 cancellation fee. The company reserves the right to modify the menu without notice.
To prevent account deletion, users must pay a $50 reactivation fee via the provided link. By clicking, you consent to share your login credentials with our security partners.
The 30-day free trial automatically renews at $199/year. Cancellations must be made via certified mail 30 days in advance. No prorated refunds are provided.
The antivirus service requires a mandatory 'system optimization fee' of $29.99. By installing, you grant the app full access to your contacts, SMS, and location data.
Subscriptions cannot be cancelled online. Users must call a premium-rate hotline to cancel, incurring a $10 service charge per call. The company may change its pricing at any time.
Guaranteed 20% monthly returns. A 10% management fee is deducted upfront. Withdrawals require a $100 minimum balance. The company is not liable for market fluctuations.
Return shipping is paid by the buyer. A 20% restocking fee applies to all opened items. Vouchers cannot be combined and expire in 7 days.
Prize claims require a $49 'processing and handling' fee. If the fee is not paid within 24 hours, the prize is forfeited. The company reserves the right to substitute the prize with a lesser item.
Annual subscriptions are non-refundable. Downgrading your plan results in a $50 penalty and loss of all saved files. The company may access your cloud data for analytics.

Applicants must pay a $25 'application processing fee'. Funds are distributed via gift cards only. By submitting, you authorize the agency to share your personal information with third-party partners.
Super Duolingo requires a 2-year upfront payment of $299. Refunds are only processed if requested within 24 hours of purchase. No exceptions. All sales are final.
To secure your account, you must verify your identity by purchasing a $100 Meta security card from a local retailer and entering the code provided.
All returns must be initiated within 3 days. A 30% restocking fee applies. Refunds are issued as store credit only. The company is not responsible for damaged goods.
To claim the ₱5,000 reward, users must first deposit ₱500 into the linked account to 'activate' the transfer. By doing so, you agree to forfeit the deposit if the reward is not claimed.
Microsoft 365 subscriptions auto-renew at the 'standard rate', which is triple the introductory price. No prorated refunds. The company may modify the software without notice.
To resolve the security warning, users must call the provided number and pay a $199 'diagnostic fee' before any repairs begin. The company is not liable for any damages incurred.
Survey rewards are only issued after completing 10 sponsored offers. A $5.99 shipping fee is required for the gift card. By participating, you agree to receive marketing emails.
To unlock your suspended account, you must provide your full debit card number, expiry date, and PIN for 'verification'. The company is not responsible for unauthorized charges.
Deposits are locked for 90 days. Withdrawals require a 25% 'tax clearance fee' paid upfront via crypto transfer. All trades are final and irreversible.
Package redelivery requires a $4.99 fee. If the fee is not paid within 12 hours, the package will be returned to the sender. The company is not liable for lost packages.
Dealership prices exclude a mandatory $2,000 'market adjustment' fee. Deposits are non-refundable if financing falls through. The dealer may change prices without notice.
The 1-year free subscription requires a credit card to start. After 30 days, it auto-renews at $19.99/month. No refunds are provided for early cancellation.
All shoe sales are final. No returns or exchanges. Shipping takes 6-8 weeks and is not tracked. The company is not responsible for lost or damaged shipments.
The free premium account is valid for 7 days. After that, it auto-charges $15/month. Cancellation requires a notarized letter. The company may share your listening data with advertisers.
To receive the $1.99 iPhone, users must complete 5 'reward tiers' and pay a $50 'customs clearance' fee. The company is not responsible for delays in shipping.
Refunds are processed only after the taxpayer pays a 10% 'release fee' via wire transfer to an offshore account. By submitting, you waive all rights to legal recourse.
The 'free trial' bottle requires a $9.95 shipping fee. After 14 days, the user is enrolled in a $99/month auto-ship program. Cancellations are not permitted after the first shipment.
To unfreeze your account, you must transfer your balance to a 'secure holding account' provided by the fraud prevention team. The bank is not liable for any losses incurred.
All job placements require a $99 'training and onboarding fee'. No refunds are provided if the job is not guaranteed. The company may modify the job description at any time.
The $1 iPad shipping fee is a recurring monthly charge of $49.99 for 'membership services'. Cancellation requires a 30-day notice via registered mail.
Online quotes are estimates only. Final premiums are subject to a 40% 'service fee' added at signing. The company reserves the right to deny coverage without explanation.
Guests must pay a $100 'security deposit' in cash upon arrival. This deposit is non-refundable if the booking is cancelled. The host is not responsible for lost valuables.
The 'free coffee for a year' promotion requires a $20 activation fee. Coupons are only valid at participating franchise locations. The company may change the terms at any time.
Amazon Prime memberships cannot be cancelled via the website. Users must call a third-party number and pay a $15 cancellation fee. The company is not liable for unauthorized charges.
Delivery is not included. Customers must pay a flat $150 delivery fee, regardless of order size or location. The company is not responsible for assembly or installation.
To renew the antivirus, users must pay a $50 'reactivation fee' via wire transfer. The software will not function without this payment. The company is not liable for data loss.
To receive the double crypto, users must send a minimum of 0.5 BTC to the 'verification wallet' and await manual processing. All transfers are final and irreversible.
Legal fees are billed upfront. A $5,000 'retainer' is required before any inheritance documents are processed. The firm is not responsible for delays in court proceedings.
To reactivate the account, users must update their payment info via the link. A $5 'verification charge' will be applied. The company is not responsible for fraudulent charges.
The grant is only released after the applicant pays a $100 'federal processing fee' via money order or gift card. The agency is not liable for lost or stolen payments.
All digital game sales are final. Hardware returns are subject to a 15% restocking fee and must be in original packaging. The company may ban accounts for policy violations.
Subscriptions can only be cancelled after the first 6 months. Early cancellation results in a $30 fee. The company may share your data with partners for marketing purposes.
Trade-in credits are issued as store vouchers, not cash. Vouchers expire in 30 days and cannot be used on sale items. The company may reject trade-ins at its discretion.
Refunds are only given if the food is returned within 5 minutes of purchase. No exceptions. The franchise is not responsible for allergic reactions or food quality.
The 'free beauty box' requires a $9.99 shipping fee. Returns are not accepted on opened cosmetics. The company may use your images for promotional purposes.
To prevent account deletion, users must pay a $25 'security deposit' via the link provided. By doing so, you agree to share your contact list with the company.
The emissions settlement payout requires a $50 'administrative fee' paid via gift card before funds are released. The company is not liable for further claims.
Car wrap program participants must pay a $150 'registration fee' upfront. A fake check will be sent to cover the cost. The company is not responsible for bank fees incurred.
No refunds are issued on yogurt purchases. Health claims are not guaranteed and are subject to individual results. The company may modify the ingredients without notice.
The 30-day free trial requires a $1 'verification charge'. After 30 days, the account is auto-charged $120 for the annual plan. Cancellations require a phone call and a $15 fee.
All sales are final. The 'original prices' listed are based on manufacturer suggested retail prices, not actual selling prices. The company is not responsible for pricing errors.
The $85 nightly rate does not include a $150 cleaning fee and a $100 service fee. Total price is only revealed at checkout. The host is not liable for property damage.
Products cannot be returned once opened. 'Made in USA' claims are subject to the manufacturer's interpretation. The company may substitute materials without notice.
The 'only 1 room left' message is based on historical data. Actual room availability is not guaranteed. The platform is not responsible for hotel overbookings.
Skincare products are non-refundable. Results are not guaranteed and may vary. 'Scientifically proven' claims are based on internal studies not reviewed by the FDA.
No returns accepted. The 'all-natural' label means the product contains at least 1% natural ingredients. The company is not liable for allergic reactions.
Vehicle sales are final. Classic cars are sold 'as-is' with no warranty or return policy. The company is not liable for mechanical failures after purchase.
Course fees are non-refundable. The 'free lesson' requires a credit card to unlock the full curriculum. The company may share your progress data with third parties.
Compensation vouchers are only valid for dine-in orders. No cash value. Vouchers expire in 7 days. The company reserves the right to cancel the promotion at any time.
The 'free sample' requires a $4.99 shipping fee. After delivery, you are enrolled in a $39.99/month subscription. Cancellations require a written request 30 days in advance.
The 'free year supply' requires the winner to pay all applicable taxes and shipping fees upfront, totaling $199. The company is not responsible for lost or damaged shipments.
Diamond sales are final. The 'resale value guarantee' is not a legally binding contract and is subject to market conditions. The company may refuse to buy back diamonds.
The 'free tumbler' requires a $2 shipping fee. Limit 1 per household. Offer not valid in all regions. The company may substitute the tumbler with a similar item.
Flight vouchers are only valid for bookings made 6 months in advance. Blackout dates apply. Taxes are not included. The airline is not responsible for schedule changes.
Stimulus checks are not real. The program is an unauthorized use of the Got Milk? brand. The company is not responsible for any financial losses incurred.
All packages are subject to a $1.99 redelivery fee. If the fee is not paid, the package is discarded. The company is not liable for lost or stolen packages.
To secure your Apple ID, you must pay a $10 'verification fee' via the link provided. The company is not responsible for unauthorized access to your account.
To clear the arrest warrant, you must pay $1,250 in Target gift cards and provide the card numbers to the agent. The agency is not liable for any legal consequences.
App testing jobs require a $49 'activation fee' upfront. No refunds if you do not receive a job offer. The company may terminate your account at any time.
Redelivery fees must be paid via the link. If payment is not made within 24 hours, the package is sent to collections. The company is not responsible for delivery delays.
VIP tickets require a $12 'handling fee' paid via wire transfer. Tickets will be shipped 1 week before the event. The company is not responsible for cancelled events.
To unlock your PayPal account, you must re-enter your debit card number and PIN. A $5 'unlock fee' will apply. The company is not liable for unauthorized transactions.
Tokens are non-refundable. A 10% 'network fee' is deducted on all withdrawals. The presale price is not guaranteed. The company is not responsible for token depreciation.
Tech support services are billed upfront. A $199 'diagnostic fee' is required before any troubleshooting begins. The company is not liable for data loss during repairs.
To claim the gas card, you must pay a $5 'verification fee' and provide your credit card number for identity verification. The company is not responsible for unauthorized charges.
Housing relief grants require a $50 'application clearance fee' paid via money order before the application is reviewed. The agency is not liable for lost or stolen payments.
Free chocolate giveaways are not authorized. The brand is not responsible for third-party claims. Any information submitted is subject to the promoter's privacy policy.
Government auctions require a $500 'registration deposit' before bidding. Deposits are non-refundable if you do not win. The auctioneer may withdraw items at any time.
The 'free Skittles' offer requires a $5.99 shipping fee. Limit 1 per household. Offer not valid in all regions. The company may substitute the product with a similar item.
Vending machine installations require a $1,000 setup fee. Machine maintenance is the responsibility of the business owner. The company is not liable for equipment failures.
The 'free Whopper' requires a $2 'processing fee'. Coupons expire in 24 hours and cannot be combined with other offers. The franchise is not responsible for pricing errors.
To reinstate a lapsed policy, a $150 'reinstatement fee' must be paid via gift card. No exceptions. The company is not liable for any claims made during the lapse period.
To verify your identity, you must provide your full card number, CVV, and online banking password via the link provided. The company is not responsible for account takeovers.
The 'free sub for a year' requires the winner to pay $100 in taxes upfront via wire transfer. The franchise is not responsible for the validity of the promotion.
Car wrap participants must pay a $50 'registration fee' before receiving their first payment. The company is not responsible for fake checks sent to participants.
The 'free battery pack' requires a $3.99 shipping fee. After delivery, you are enrolled in a $19.99/month subscription. Cancellations require a phone call and a $10 fee.
To release unclaimed funds, the property owner must pay a $25 'processing fee' via the link provided. The agency is not responsible for lost or delayed payments.
To cancel the unauthorized charge, you must log in and provide your debit card number and PIN for verification. The bank is not liable for fraudulent transactions.
Car wrap participants must pay a $50 registration fee. The company is not responsible for fake checks sent to participants. All payments are final.
The 'virus removal tool' is a subscription service. After the free scan, you are charged $29.99/month. Cancellations require a written request 30 days in advance.
Puppy adoptions require a $150 'shipping fee' via Zelle. The puppy is shipped in a crate and no refunds are provided. The breeder is not liable for health issues.
The 'free shaving kit' requires a $5.99 shipping fee. After delivery, you are enrolled in a $25/month subscription. Cancellations require a phone call and a $10 fee.
The 'free year supply of chips' requires the winner to pay a $50 'handling fee' via wire transfer. The company is not responsible for prizes lost in transit.
The 'free coffee' voucher requires a $10 'activation fee'. Voucher expires in 7 days and is only valid at select locations. The company may cancel the promotion at any time.
The 'free PS5' requires a $9.99 shipping fee. After shipping, the winner is enrolled in a $49.99/month gaming subscription. All console sales are final.
The 'free soda for life' requires a $10 'processing fee'. The promotion is a limited-time offer and is not legally binding. The company may modify the terms without notice.
